debugging_guide.overview: Comprehensive guide for diagnosing and resolving AutoCAD COM integration issues. Focuses on common error patterns, debugging techniques, and systematic troubleshooting.

error_category.name: connection_errors
error_category.description: Issues with AutoCAD connection establishment and maintenance

error.description: Class not registered - AutoCAD not installed or COM not registered

solutions.solution: Verify AutoCAD 2025 is installed and properly licensed
Run AutoCAD at least once to register COM components
Check if running as administrator (may be required)
Use repair installation if AutoCAD COM registration is corrupted

error.description: AutoCAD takes too long to respond or start

symptoms.symptom: AutoCAD window appears but doesn't respond to COM calls

solutions.solution: Increase timeout values in connection manager
Ensure AutoCAD is not busy with other operations
Close unnecessary AutoCAD documents
Use GetActiveObject instead of creating new instance

error_category.name: parameter_errors
error_category.description: Issues with parameter marshalling and data type conversion

error.description: Invalid number of parameters or invalid parameter type

symptoms.symptom: Most common COM error in AutoCAD automation
Usually caused by incorrect VARIANT array format
Geometry creation methods fail with this error

solutions.solution: Verify VARIANT array creation uses correct VT_ARRAY | VT_R8 format
Ensure coordinates are properly converted to float values
Check parameter order matches AutoCAD API specification
Validate all parameters are non-null before marshalling

error.debug_code:
# Debug parameter marshalling def debug_variant_array(coordinates): """Debug VARIANT array creation and contents.""" try: print(f"Input coordinates: {coordinates}") print(f"Coordinate type: {type(coordinates)}") print(f"Coordinate length: {len(coordinates)}")
# Test VARIANT array creation variant = win32com.client.VARIANT( pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, coordinates )
print(f"VARIANT created successfully: {variant}") return variant
except Exception as e: print(f"VARIANT creation failed: {e}") raise

error.description: Python data types don't match AutoCAD COM expectations

symptoms.symptom: Parameters accepted but geometry created incorrectly

solutions.solution: Explicitly convert all numeric values to float
Ensure coordinate tuples/lists have correct dimensions
Verify unit system consistency (inches, mm, etc.)
Use ensure_3d_coordinates() for all point data

error_category.name: geometry_errors
error_category.description: Issues with geometric entity creation and manipulation

symptoms.symptom: Arc creation fails with invalid angles

solutions.solution: Add comprehensive parameter validation before AutoCAD calls
Implement geometric constraint checking
Provide meaningful error messages for invalid parameters
Use default values for optional parameters

error.description: Created entity cannot be found or accessed

symptoms.symptom: SendCommand operations complete but entity not in model space
Entity creation succeeds but returned object is invalid
Property access fails on created entities

solutions.solution: Add delay after SendCommand operations
Implement polling to find newly created entities
Use direct API methods instead of SendCommand when possible
Verify entity creation in correct document/model space

error.polling_code:
def find_created_entity(entity_type="AcDbHelix", max_attempts=10): """Poll model space to find newly created entity.""" import time
for attempt in range(max_attempts): # Check recent entities in model space count = model_space.Count for i in range(min(5, count)): # Check last 5 entities try: entity = model_space.Item(count - 1 - i) if hasattr(entity, 'ObjectName') and entity.ObjectName == entity_type: print(f"Found {entity_type} on attempt {attempt + 1}") return entity except: continue
# Wait before next attempt time.sleep(0.1)
print(f"Entity {entity_type} not found after {max_attempts} attempts") return None

error.description: COM objects not properly released causing memory leaks

symptoms.symptom: AutoCAD becomes unresponsive after many operations
System performance degrades during long operations

solutions.solution: Explicitly set COM object references to None
Use proper cleanup in finally blocks
Implement object pooling for frequently used objects
Monitor COM object lifecycle
Batch multiple operations to reduce API call overhead
Use background processing for long operations
Cache frequently accessed objects and properties
Profile and optimize bottleneck operations

tool.name: logging_setup
tool.description: Comprehensive logging configuration for AutoCAD debugging
tool.code_example:
import logging import sys
def setup_autocad_logging(log_level=logging.DEBUG): """Set up comprehensive logging for AutoCAD operations."""
# Create logger logger = logging.getLogger('autocad_debug') logger.setLevel(log_level)
# Remove existing handlers for handler in logger.handlers[:]: logger.removeHandler(handler)
# Console handler console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout) console_handler.setLevel(log_level)
# File handler file_handler = logging.FileHandler('autocad_debug.log', mode='w') file_handler.setLevel(log_level)
# Formatter formatter = logging.Formatter( '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(funcName)s:%(lineno)d - %(message)s' ) console_handler.setFormatter(formatter) file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
# Add handlers logger.addHandler(console_handler) logger.addHandler(file_handler)
return logger
# Usage debug_logger = setup_autocad_logging()
def log_autocad_operation(operation_name, parameters, result=None, error=None): """Log AutoCAD operation with parameters and results.""" if error: debug_logger.error(f"{operation_name} failed: {error}") debug_logger.error(f"Parameters: {parameters}") else: debug_logger.debug(f"{operation_name} succeeded") debug_logger.debug(f"Parameters: {parameters}") if result: debug_logger.debug(f"Result: {result}")
